stages.label: Plan
stages.description: Refine the feature spec into testable user stories; every AC is measurable.

stages.label: Design
stages.description: Design the module against its contract; every AC maps to a design element.

stages.label: Develop
stages.description: Implement the module inside the agent's path scope; static guardrails must pass.

stages.label: Test
stages.description: Run the immutable acceptance suite and the behavioural eval against the candidate.

stages.label: Review
stages.description: Security and policy review; LLM-judge score against the spec rubric.

stages.label: Deploy
stages.description: All gate statuses green and a human approval, then merge and deploy to edge-staging.

spec-frontmatter.description: Plan keeps the feature id, owner agent and contract from the spec.

acceptance-criteria-present.description: Every AC id in the spec appears in the plan.

contract-conformance.description: Design names every export the contract requires.

dependency-allowlist.description: Only node: built-ins and edge/reference/fleet.js may be imported.

path-scope.description: An agent may only write inside its own scope in the roster.

secret-scan.description: No API keys, tokens, private keys or connection strings.

syntax-check.description: The module parses as an ES module.

no-dynamic-exec.description: No eval, new Function, child_process or network calls in edge code.

plaintext-transport.description: No mqtt://, ws://, non-localhost http://, rejectUnauthorized:false, tls:false or insecure:true — every cross-zone link is TLS with certificates (security.md §3).

ot-write-prohibited.description: Edge analytics is read-only towards OT: no Modbus/OPC-UA writes or setpoint changes (IEC 62443 zones and conduits).

tests-immutable.description: Agents cannot edit acceptance tests; only the Test agent runs them.

prompt-injection.description: Memories recalled from Meko are screened for instruction-injection before they reach a prompt.

memory-provenance.description: Recalled memories must come from a roster agent or the org standards bucket.

token-budget.description: Input tokens per stage stay under the agent's budget.

all-checks-green.description: Every adlc/* commit status on the PR head is success.

human-approval.description: The feature's human owner (or the release manager) approves the deploy.

spec-completeness.description: Share of rubric items present: stories, ACs, non-goals, risks, telemetry.

ac-coverage.description: Share of spec ACs referenced by the design.

contract-exports.description: Share of required exports the module actually exports.

acceptance-pass-rate.description: Passing acceptance tests / total, run against the candidate only.

behavioural.description: Feature-specific: F02 precision ≥ 0.9 and recall ≥ 0.9 on a labelled simulation; F06 golden-set intent accuracy = 1.0; others: scenario replay.

llm-judge.description: Reviewer model scores the change against the spec rubric (0–1).
